settings.note: viewGain is a display control only; it does not change physical state.

review.notes: The reservoir issue feels better.  So does the amount of time the brush takes to run out.  The bending and lagging is very understated which is why I haven't green marked it.  The board needs a red mark, which means I've checked it and it needs recalibration.  When selected as Red, a popover can appear  with an area for me to state my reasoning for wanting that item recalibrated.  I don't want to separately submit that, either.  It can just submit when I select "Save this mark".  That way we can be specific about what is and is not working after testing.  These settings as well, reservoir, belly size, etc. need to land in the Brush Studio.  I don't want to lose site of that goal as well.  Finally, when I hit "Save this mark", let's update the form so it's clean and just use a modal window that informs me that it was successfully submitted (or failed) and that's about it.

BR-01.note: Re-judged with the filbert on 2026-08-21 and approved. The earlier mark-down was made with the disc, which is sized in cells and cannot hold a true millimetre size.

BR-02.note: Re-judged with the filbert on 2026-08-21 and approved. The earlier mark-down was made with the disc, which is round and marks the same in every direction.

BR-03.note: Marked down 2026-08-21 while testing with the disc, which cannot demonstrate this. The artist disowned the test; restored to machine-checked, awaiting a judgement made with a drawn brush.

BR-04.note: Set to partial 2026-08-21. The disc can feather, so this judgement stands on its own feet and is left alone.

BR-05.note: Judged with the filbert on 2026-08-21 and left at partial: "Paint runs out very quickly - too quickly, actually." Measured at 42% of a full dip for one 8 cm oil stroke. Reworked the same day - capacity and release are now separate per-brush numbers, reach is roughly 3.7x further, and auto-reload is on by default with an adjustable amount. Awaiting a re-test.

BR-06.note: Re-judged with the filbert on 2026-08-21 and left at partial. Supersedes the earlier disc mark-down; BX-03 "its hair feels right" is partial for the same reason.
